content: SkillTek Institute (also known as The Skilltek Institute & Media Solutions) is located in Thatta. Slogans: "Empowering Skills, Shaping Futures" and "Learn today, lead tomorrow." SkillTek delivers quality education through industry-aligned programs, experienced faculty and a fully digital campus, supporting students from admission to graduation. Our story: SkillTek Institute was founded with a simple mission: to make quality, industry-relevant education accessible to everyone. Experienced faculty, a modern curriculum and a digital-first approach. From admissions to graduation, technology keeps students, teachers and administrators connected on a single platform. Mission: Deliver practical, affordable and modern education. People: Passionate teachers and a supportive community. Promise: Quality learning, measurable results.

Qualified Faculty: experienced and certified instructors dedicated to student success. Practical Curriculum: industry-aligned programs reviewed and updated on a regular cycle. Modern Campus: purpose-built classrooms and labs for focused, hands-on learning. Career & Placement: guidance and placement support to help graduates start their careers. Digital Student Portal: a dedicated portal (Login Portal on the website, /login) where students stay connected to notices and their course. A mobile app is available from the website's Download App page (/download). 24/7 Assistance: an AI assistant answers admission, program and tech-solution queries at any hour. The website also lists: Affiliated Programs, Certified Faculty, Placement Support.

Founder / CEO: Sarfaraz Ahmed — Experienced IT Instructor, Trainer, Educationist & Marketing Professional; Social & Youth Activist. He has a strong background in IT, education, marketing and social activism, empowers individuals through skill-building and mentorship, and has a track record in youth development and community engagement. Co-Founder / CTO: Sarwar Ali — Data Scientist, AI Enthusiast, Automation + Agentic AI Developer and IT Trainer. He designs intelligent workflows and AI-powered systems and leads SkillTek's technology and curriculum direction.

SkillTek currently lists these programs: (1) Agentic AI And Automation — 2 months. (2) Certificate in Information Technology (CIT) — 6 months. (3) Certificate in Information Technology (Night Batch) — 6 months, the same CIT course in a night batch. Fees, batch timings and start dates are not published on the website; for those, contact the admissions desk at 0312 2098894 or theskilltek@gmail.com.

Agentic AI And Automation (2 months): Learn to build intelligent AI agents and automate everyday tasks and business workflows using modern AI tools. Gain practical skills in workflow automation, AI-powered decision-making, chatbots, and smart systems to improve productivity and efficiency with minimal human intervention. It is a no-code & low-code program: no traditional coding background is required. Tools taught include n8n (main platform), Make, Zapier, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Supabase, Google Sheets, Airtable, WhatsApp Cloud API, Telegram and Gmail, plus MCP, RAG, tool calling, multi-agent systems and human-in-the-loop automation. 14 modules: 01 AI Fundamentals; 02 Prompt Engineering; 03 n8n Workflow Automation; 04 API & Webhook Integration; 05 AI Agent Development; 06 Databases & Integrations; 07 RAG & Knowledge-Based Agents; 08 Model Context Protocol (MCP); 09 Multi-Agent Systems; 10 WhatsApp AI Automation; 11 Business Process Automation; 12 Advanced AI Automation; 13 Deployment & Hosting; 14 Freelancing & AI Agency.

Certificate in Information Technology (CIT) — 6 months. Also offered as a Night Batch. A comprehensive, practical, and career-oriented computer training course designed to equip students with essential digital skills and computer knowledge. Hands-on training in computer fundamentals, Microsoft Office applications, internet and email usage, typing skills, file management, and essential digital tools. Students learn to create professional documents, manage spreadsheets, prepare presentations, browse the internet effectively, and perform everyday computer tasks with confidence.

Admission process (4 steps): 1) Submit the online admission enquiry form (on the Admissions page of the SkillTek website, or the Apply form on the Agentic AI course page). 2) Our team calls you to discuss the course and details. 3) Visit the institute with documents and complete enrollment. 4) Get your student portal login and start learning. The website says: "Applications for the Fall 2026 intake are now open." Admissions desk phone: 0312 2098894. Email: theskilltek@gmail.com.

Documents needed for enrollment: CNIC / B-Form copy; Recent photographs; Last qualification certificate. Eligibility rules, fees, deadlines and batch schedules are not published — the admissions team confirms these on the call.

Address: Near Dargah Shah Mubeen, Beside Dr Luchman Clinic, Doctor Street, Thatta. Phone (admissions desk): 0312 2098894. Email: theskilltek@gmail.com. Website contact page has a message form (Full name, Phone, Email, Message). Office hours are not published.

Beyond education, SkillTek Media Solutions builds and grows businesses. Services: Website Development (fast, responsive websites and web apps, from landing pages to full portals); Digital Marketing (social media, paid ads, SEO and content); AI Automation (chatbots, AI assistants and smart workflows that answer and assist 24/7); Business Automation (operations, billing, CRM and internal tools); Mobile Apps (Android and iOS); Branding & Design (logos, UI/UX and brand identity); and more. Offer: free consultation & project scoping, clear quotes with defined timelines, ongoing support after delivery. To request a solution, use the form on the Services page or contact 0312 2098894 / theskilltek@gmail.com. Prices are quoted per project and are not published.

Students' status can be verified on the official Verify Status page: https://skilltek-one.vercel.app/verify — enter a SkillTek Institute roll number and press Verify. The assistant cannot look up or confirm any student's status, results or records itself, and must never guess. For problems with verification, contact 0312 2098894 or theskilltek@gmail.com.
